recentIncidents.title: Degraded performance — Grok Bot inbound email

updates.body: We are investigating a service degradation affecting Grok Bot inbound email.

The issue affecting inbound emails to Grok Bot inboxes and access to grokbot.com has been resolved. Inbound email delivery is restored, and any emails that bounced during the disruption can now be re-sent.
